name: hymd
description: HyMD — Markdown 超集格式与可拔插块引擎

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hymd/parser && npm run build -w @hymd/blocks-sheet && npm run build -w @hymd/layout && npm run build -w @hymd/export && npm run build -w @hymd/webview-core && npm run build -w @hymd/host-web && npm run build -w hymd-editor
scripts.build:host: npm run build:host-web && dotnet build apps/hymd-host/hymd-host.csproj -c Debug
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hymd/blocks-sheet && npm run test -w @hymd/parser && npm run test -w @hymd/layout && npm run test -w @hymd/export && npm run test -w @hymd/webview-core && npm run test -w hymd-editor
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hymd/parser && npm run typecheck -w @hymd/blocks-sheet && npm run typecheck -w @hymd/layout && npm run typecheck -w @hymd/export && npm run typecheck -w @hymd/webview-core && npm run typecheck -w @hymd/host-web && npm run typecheck -w hymd-editor
